title: Stuffed Eggplant
subtitle: with Veggie 'Mince' and Currants
description: Made with vegetables, wheat, barley and sunflower seeds, these wholesome patties make a great stand in for mince. Crumble into the pan and fry up with coriander and spices, stuff into eggplant shells and top with roasted eggplant dip.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Preheat the oven to 220C. Line an oven tray with baking paper. Crush 2 garlic cloves. Halve the eggplant lengthwise. Finely chop the onion. Finely chop the coriander leaves and stems, keeping them separate.
Bake eggplant: Put the eggplant on the lined tray and spray or brush with olive oil. Roast for 25 mins or until very tender (cover with baking paper if browning too quickly).

Cook filling: Meanwhile, heat 1 tbs olive oil in a medium frypan over high heat. Crumble the vegetable patties into the pan. Add the onion, coriander stems, half the garlic and 2 tsp cumin and coriander spice blend and cook, stirring, for 1-2 mins until fragrant. Add the currants and 2 tbs tomato paste, season with salt and pepper and stir to combine.

Stuff eggplant: Add 60ml (¼ cup) water to the filling mixture and cook for 1 min or until thickened (see Kitchen tip). Remove the pan from the heat. Scoop out the flesh from the eggplant halves, leaving a 1cm-thick border of flesh (take care not to split the skin). Reserve the flesh. Stuff the eggplant cases with the filling.

Serve up: Finely chop the reserved eggplant flesh. Massage the tahini packet to combine well. Put the eggplant flesh, remaining garlic, half the tahini and 2 tsp red wine vinegar in a bowl, season with salt and pepper and stir to combine. Divide the stuffed eggplant among plates, top with the eggplant dip, scatter over the coriander leaves and enjoy!
Kitchen tip: The veggie patties tend to absorb a lot of liquid, so don't worry if the filling mixture starts to look really thick – just remove the pan from the heat.
